# Data

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# samples
sp <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_samples+acquisitions_cleaned.csv")) 

# daytime factor
varfactor <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_samples_marine_regions+daytime.csv")) %>% 
  # one summer Arctic sample is missing a day value
  mutate(day_night=if_else(sampleid==378000027,"Day",day_night))

# objects
allobjects <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_objects_morpho_taxo_cleaned.csv")) %>% 
  left_join(distinct(sp,acquisid,sampleid,genid,d,date,latitude,longitude))
```

# Formatting for samples mean

Necessary input columns to Cephalopod: **"decimallatitude", "decimallongitude", "depth", "year", "month", "scientificname", "worms_id", "measurementvalue", "measurementunit", "taxonrank"**

Note that depth is only used for excluding or including samples so we will set the same depth for all samples, Cephalopod does not output 3D maps.

All communities within 1x1 degree square will be averaged during Cephalopod.

## Community

```{r}
com <- allobjects %>% 
  mutate(year=year(date),
         month=month(date)) %>% 
  group_by(genid,decimallatitude=latitude,decimallongitude=longitude,year,month) %>% 
  summarize(measurementvalue=sum(grey_median*d)/sum(d)) %>% 
  mutate(measurementunit="0-255",
         taxonrank="Kingdom",
         scientificname="all",
         worms_id="all",
         depth=200) %>% 
  # add the varfactor day/night 
  left_join(distinct(varfactor,genid,varfactor=day_night))
```

## Class/phylum

```{r}
class <- allobjects %>% 
  mutate(year=year(date),
         month=month(date)) %>% 
  group_by(genid,decimallatitude=latitude,decimallongitude=longitude,year,month,scientificname=class_phylum) %>% 
  summarize(measurementvalue=sum(grey_median*d)/sum(d)) %>% 
  mutate(measurementunit="0-255",
         taxonrank="Kingdom",
         worms_id=scientificname,
         depth=200) %>% 
  # add the varfactor day/night 
  left_join(distinct(varfactor,genid,varfactor=day_night))
```

# Export

```{r}
# put all and classes together (Cephalopod will run all as any of the other classes)
write_csv(bind_rows(com,class),file.path(cfg$project$data,"cephalopod_samples_greymedian_mean_com+class.csv"))
```
